note: Documents reuse the 20 requests, filler, question and delimiter of bench_position_sensitivity.py; the request sits at `needle_position` of the filler, so 1.0 is the cell that script measures. Lengths are filler tokens under the classic tokenizer; the Vega reader's own input_tokens and truncation flag are reported per case. n=20 per cell: intervals are wide and a null is underpowered, not equivalence.
